_about: MAYA's career library. 'profile' says how much each career draws on each assessment dimension (0-3); 'must' lists dimensions the career really can't do without, so a student who scores very low on one is told plainly. Earnings are indicative Indian ranges gathered in 2025-26 from the sources listed with each career — salaries vary widely by city, employer and skill, and change every year.

careers.name: Computer Science & Software Engineering
careers.description: Design and build the software behind apps, websites, banking, games and AI.
careers.education_path: Class 11-12 with PCM → B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (4 years) via JEE Main/Advanced, state CETs or BITSAT → optional M.Tech/MS.
careers.timeline: 4 years after class 12; you can start coding today.
possible_challenges: Very competitive at top colleges
Technology changes fast — you keep learning all your career
explore_next: Try CS50 or freeCodeCamp for a month
Build one small app or website

details.overview: Software engineers turn ideas into working programs. Every bank, hospital, shop and government office now runs on software, so CS graduates work almost everywhere — from startups to ISRO.
details.day_in_life: Writing and reviewing code, fixing bugs, discussing designs with teammates, and testing features before they reach users. Most work is at a computer, often in teams.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: take PCM. Maths matters most — it's what CS is built on.
Prepare for JEE Main (and JEE Advanced if you're aiming for IITs); also consider BITSAT and your state CET.
Learn one programming language (Python is a good first one) alongside school — it helps even in the first year of college.
In college: learn data structures and algorithms, do internships, and build projects you can show.
start_now: Finish the first 3 weeks of CS50 (free)
Write a small program that solves a problem you have — a timetable, a quiz, a calculator

entrance_exams.name: JEE Main
entrance_exams.note: NITs, IIITs and many state colleges; qualifies you for JEE Advanced

resources.name: CS50 — Harvard's free intro to computer science

details.future_scope: Demand stays strong, but the easiest coding jobs are being automated by AI tools — graduates who understand fundamentals, AI and system design do best.

earnings.entry: ₹3.5–7 LPA at IT services firms; ₹12–30 LPA at top product companies
earnings.mid: ₹15–40 LPA after 5–8 years (much higher at top product firms)
earnings.senior: ₹40 LPA and above for senior engineers and architects
earnings.note: IIT graduates' median package was about ₹19–20 LPA in NIRF 2025 data; most NITs about ₹11–13 LPA.

careers.name: Data Science & Artificial Intelligence
careers.description: Teach computers to find patterns in data — recommendations, medical scans, fraud detection, chatbots.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in CSE/AI & Data Science (4 years), or B.Sc Maths/Statistics → M.Sc/M.Tech in Data Science or AI.
careers.timeline: 4–6 years after class 12 (many roles prefer a master's).
possible_challenges: Maths-heavy — statistics and linear algebra
Fast-moving field that needs constant learning
explore_next: Try Kaggle's free Python and Intro to ML courses
Analyse a small dataset — e.g. your own exam marks

details.overview: Data scientists and AI engineers build systems that learn from data. It sits between computer science and statistics, and is used in healthcare, banking, agriculture, e-commerce and research.
details.day_in_life: Cleaning and exploring data, training and testing models, explaining results to teams, and making models work reliably in real products.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM, with strong maths (probability and statistics especially).
JEE Main/Advanced for B.Tech in CSE or AI & Data Science; or B.Sc in Maths/Statistics via CUET.
Learn Python early; then NumPy, pandas and basic machine learning.
In college: projects, Kaggle competitions and internships matter as much as marks.
start_now: Kaggle Learn: Python, then Intro to Machine Learning
Watch 3Blue1Brown's neural network series

resources.name: Kaggle Learn — free hands-on data science
NPTEL — Machine Learning, Data Science courses

details.future_scope: One of the fastest-growing fields; roles are shifting from building basic models to building on large AI systems safely and usefully.

earnings.entry: ₹6–9 LPA typical; ₹12–20 LPA for top-college graduates at product companies
earnings.senior: ₹40 LPA+ for senior ML engineers and leads
earnings.note: Freshers from tier-2/3 colleges at IT services firms often start at ₹4.5–8 LPA.

sources.name: Futurense — data scientist salaries in India

careers.name: Cybersecurity
careers.description: Protect computers, networks and people's data from attacks — find the weak spots before criminals do.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in CSE or CSE (Cyber Security) via JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs, or BCA / B.Sc Computer Science via CUET → hands-on practice (CTF competitions) and security certifications.
careers.timeline: 3–4 years after class 12; practice and certifications count as much as the degree.
possible_challenges: Attacks and tools change every year — you keep learning all the time
Entry-level security-operations jobs often include night shifts
explore_next: Try the beginner challenges on picoCTF
Take Cisco Networking Academy's free Introduction to Cybersecurity

details.overview: Cybersecurity professionals defend banks, hospitals, companies and government systems against hackers, fraud and data leaks. Some watch for attacks as they happen, some test systems by trying to break in (with permission), and some design systems to be safe from the start.
details.day_in_life: Watching alerts in a security operations centre, investigating suspicious activity, testing websites and apps for weaknesses, fixing what's found, and explaining risks to people who aren't technical.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM, with computer science if your school offers it.
JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs for B.Tech in CSE or CSE (Cyber Security); or CUET for BCA / B.Sc Computer Science.
Learn networking and the Linux command line early — most security work builds on them.
Practise legally on Capture-the-Flag (CTF) platforms; certifications like CompTIA Security+ help with a first job.
start_now: picoCTF — free beginner security challenges
OverTheWire Bandit — learn Linux by solving puzzles

entrance_exams.name: JEE Main
entrance_exams.note: B.Tech CSE / Cyber Security at NITs, IIITs and many state colleges

entrance_exams.name: CUET-UG
entrance_exams.note: BCA / B.Sc Computer Science at central universities

resources.name: picoCTF — free security challenges for beginners
Cisco Networking Academy — Introduction to Cybersecurity (free)
OverTheWire — learn Linux and security through games
CERT-In — India's national cyber security agency

details.future_scope: Demand keeps rising as more of India's payments, records and services go online, and as data-protection rules make companies responsible for keeping data safe.

earnings.entry: ₹4–6 LPA typical for freshers (PayScale's average about ₹4.7 LPA)
earnings.mid: ₹7–20 LPA after 3–6 years, depending on employer and specialisation
earnings.senior: ₹20–35 LPA after 7–10 years; more at top multinationals
earnings.note: Recognised certifications often add to a fresher's starting offer. Ranges vary widely by city and employer.

sources.name: Futurense — cybersecurity analyst salaries in India

careers.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
careers.description: Design chips, circuits, phones, communication networks and embedded devices.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in ECE (4 years) → optional M.Tech (VLSI, communication) via GATE.
possible_challenges: Core electronics jobs are fewer than software jobs
Physics- and maths-heavy
explore_next: Build a simple circuit with an Arduino kit
Read about how a phone sends a signal

details.overview: ECE engineers make the hardware of the modern world — from the chips inside phones to satellites and 5G networks. India is investing heavily in semiconductor manufacturing, which is creating new core jobs.
details.day_in_life: Designing and simulating circuits, testing boards in the lab, writing code for embedded systems, and working with manufacturers.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM with a strong grip on electricity, magnetism and semiconductors in physics.
JEE Main/Advanced for NITs/IITs; state CETs for state colleges.
Play with Arduino or Raspberry Pi projects — they teach you how electronics really behave.
In college: aim for VLSI/embedded internships; GATE opens PSU jobs and M.Tech.
start_now: Try a beginner Arduino project (LED, sensor)
Revise NCERT Physics chapters on current electricity and semiconductors
details.future_scope: Rising: India's semiconductor mission, 5G/6G and electric vehicles all need ECE engineers.

earnings.entry: ₹3–5.5 LPA at many private firms; ₹6–10 LPA at PSUs via GATE; ₹18–30 LPA at top semiconductor/VLSI companies
earnings.senior: ₹30 LPA+ in chip design and leadership
earnings.note: Top VLSI roles need strong fundamentals and usually an M.Tech or excellent internships.

sources.name: EduRev — GATE ECE salaries (PSU vs private)

careers.name: Robotics & Automation
careers.description: Design machines that sense, think and move — factory robot arms, drones, warehouse robots and rovers.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Robotics/Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics or Electrical via JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs → an M.Tech in robotics for research and advanced roles.
careers.timeline: 4 years after class 12; many advanced robotics roles prefer a master's.
possible_challenges: You need mechanics, electronics and coding together — few people are strong in all three at first
Pure robotics jobs are fewer than general engineering jobs; many start in automation or embedded roles
explore_next: Build a line-follower robot with an Arduino kit
Join or start a school robotics club, or enter a robotics competition

details.overview: Robotics engineers bring together mechanical design, electronics and software to build machines that work on their own — in factories, warehouses, hospitals, farms and space missions. Much of the work in India today is industrial automation.
details.day_in_life: Designing parts in CAD, wiring sensors and motors, writing the code that controls them, testing robots and figuring out why they didn't do what you expected.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM, with computer science if possible.
JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs for B.Tech in Robotics/Mechatronics, Mechanical, Electronics or Electrical.
Build things: Arduino or Raspberry Pi projects teach electronics and coding together.
In college: robotics clubs and competitions (e.g. e-Yantra, Robocon) and internships in automation.
start_now: Arduino's free tutorials — make an LED blink, then a motor move
Build a line-follower robot from a kit

entrance_exams.name: JEE Main
entrance_exams.note: B.Tech at NITs, IIITs and many state colleges

resources.name: e-Yantra (IIT Bombay) — robotics competitions and projects

details.future_scope: Automation in Indian factories and warehouses is growing, along with drones and robots in agriculture and healthcare; robotics combined with AI is where much of the newest work is.

earnings.entry: ₹4–6 LPA typical to start (PayScale's entry-level average about ₹3.9 LPA)
earnings.mid: About ₹5–10 LPA after a few years; more at larger automation and product companies
earnings.senior: Up to about ₹20 LPA for experienced engineers
earnings.note: There are few reliable salary surveys for robotics in India and they rest on small samples; figures vary a lot by city and employer.

sources.name: PayScale — robotics engineer salary in India

careers.name: Electrical Engineering
careers.description: Generate, move and control electricity — power plants, grids, EVs, solar and motors.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Electrical/EEE (4 years) → GATE for PSUs or M.Tech.
possible_challenges: Some site and plant work
Core jobs cluster in PSUs and big industry
explore_next: Look up how India's power grid reaches your home
Learn how a solar panel works

details.overview: Electrical engineers keep the lights on — and are central to India's shift to solar, wind and electric vehicles.
details.day_in_life: Designing and maintaining power systems, testing motors and control systems, and working at plants, substations or design offices.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM; electricity and magnetism are the heart of this field.
JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs.
In college: GATE is the main route to PSUs such as NTPC, POWERGRID and BHEL.
start_now: Revise NCERT chapters on current electricity and electromagnetic induction
Watch how a transformer works
details.future_scope: Strong: renewable energy and EV targets need a lot of electrical engineers over the next decade.

earnings.entry: ₹3–5 LPA in private firms; ₹6–10 LPA at PSUs via GATE
earnings.senior: ₹25 LPA+ in senior and leadership roles
earnings.note: PSU jobs come with strong job security and allowances.

careers.name: Mechanical Engineering
careers.description: Design and build machines — engines, cars, robots, factories and turbines.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Mechanical (4 years) → GATE/M.Tech or industry.
possible_challenges: Starting salaries in core jobs are modest
Factory/site postings are common
explore_next: Take apart (and rebuild) something mechanical
Try free CAD software like FreeCAD

details.overview: The broadest engineering branch: mechanical engineers work on anything that moves or uses energy — cars, aircraft, robots, air-conditioners and power plants.
details.day_in_life: Designing parts in CAD, testing prototypes, solving problems on factory floors, and improving how things are made.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM; mechanics and thermodynamics are the core.
JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs.
Join robotics or motorsport (SAE/BAJA) clubs in college — employers value them.
start_now: Revise NCERT chapters on laws of motion and thermodynamics
Try FreeCAD or Tinkercad to design a simple part
details.future_scope: Changing: electric vehicles, robotics and 3D printing are creating new roles; mechanical engineers who add software skills do especially well.

earnings.entry: ₹3–6 LPA typical; ₹6–9 LPA at PSUs via GATE
earnings.senior: ₹20 LPA+ in senior engineering and plant leadership
earnings.note: Core manufacturing starts lower; IT-adjacent and design roles start higher.

sources.name: GUVI — mechanical engineer salary in India

careers.name: Civil Engineering
careers.description: Plan and build roads, bridges, metros, dams, buildings and water systems.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Civil (4 years) → GATE for PSUs/M.Tech or state engineering services.
possible_challenges: Lots of on-site and outdoor work
Private starting pay can be low
explore_next: Visit a construction site with an adult and watch the process
Read about how a metro line is built

details.overview: Civil engineers build the country — India's huge spending on highways, railways, metros and housing keeps them in steady demand.
details.day_in_life: Supervising construction sites, checking designs and materials, planning schedules and budgets, and solving problems as a project grows.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM.
JEE Main/Advanced or state CETs.
In college: learn AutoCAD and structural software; GATE leads to PSU and government engineering jobs.
start_now: Notice how buildings and bridges near you are designed and ask why
Try a free AutoCAD tutorial
details.future_scope: Steady: infrastructure building, smart cities and climate-resilient construction keep demand high.

earnings.entry: ₹3.5–6 LPA typical; ₹6–10 LPA from IITs/NITs; ₹12–18 LPA CTC at PSUs via GATE
earnings.senior: ₹20 LPA+ for senior project and structural roles
earnings.note: Government engineering jobs add stability and allowances.

careers.name: Chemical Engineering
careers.description: Turn chemistry into products at scale — fuels, medicines, fertilisers, plastics, food.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Chemical Engineering (4 years) → industry, GATE/PSU or M.Tech.
possible_challenges: Plant postings can be in industrial areas
Fewer colleges offer it
explore_next: Read how petrol is made from crude oil
Revise NCERT physical chemistry

details.overview: Chemical engineers design and run the plants that make everyday materials safely and efficiently — from medicines to green hydrogen.
details.day_in_life: Monitoring and improving plant processes, running simulations, ensuring safety, and scaling lab reactions to factory size.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM with strong chemistry.
JEE Main/Advanced.
In college: internships at plants; GATE for PSUs like IOCL, ONGC, GAIL.
start_now: Revise NCERT chemistry chapters on thermodynamics and equilibrium
Watch a documentary on how medicines are manufactured
details.future_scope: Growing in green hydrogen, batteries, and sustainable materials.

earnings.entry: ₹4–8 LPA typical; higher at top PSUs and oil majors
earnings.senior: ₹25 LPA+ in plant leadership
earnings.note: Indicative range; varies strongly by industry and plant.

careers.name: Aerospace Engineering
careers.description: Design aircraft, rockets, drones and satellites.
careers.education_path: PCM → B.Tech in Aerospace/Aeronautical (IITs, IIST, some NITs/private) → M.Tech/research.
possible_challenges: Few seats and few core employers
Very physics- and maths-heavy
explore_next: Build and fly a paper or balsa glider and change its wing shape
Read about ISRO's missions

details.overview: Aerospace engineers work on flight — India's space programme and growing drone and aircraft industry are creating opportunities.
details.day_in_life: Aerodynamic simulations, structural analysis, testing components, and working in large, careful teams.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM, excellent in physics and maths.
JEE Advanced (IITs) or IIST's admission via JEE Advanced scores.
Aeromodelling and rocketry clubs help a lot.
start_now: Learn the four forces of flight
Follow ISRO mission updates
details.future_scope: Growing with India's private space sector and drone policy, but still a smaller job market than CS or mechanical.

earnings.entry: ₹5–10 LPA typical; ISRO/DRDO scientists start at central pay Level 10 (₹56,100 basic)
earnings.senior: ₹30 LPA+ in senior roles
earnings.note: Indicative; government scientist pay follows the 7th Pay Commission matrix.

sources.name: Level-10 pay (₹56,100–1,77,500) per Govt. of India notice

careers.name: Architecture
careers.description: Design buildings and spaces that are beautiful, safe and useful.
careers.education_path: PCM (maths compulsory) → B.Arch (5 years) via NATA or JEE Main Paper 2A → register with the Council of Architecture.
possible_challenges: Long hours on design projects
Starting salaries are modest; grows with experience
explore_next: Sketch your room or school building from different angles
Look at famous Indian architects like B. V. Doshi

details.overview: Architects combine art and engineering to design homes, offices, public spaces and cities.
details.day_in_life: Sketching and modelling designs, meeting clients, working with engineers, and visiting sites.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM (maths is required).
Practise freehand drawing and perspective.
Take NATA and/or JEE Main Paper 2A (B.Arch).
start_now: Draw one building every day for a month
Try SketchUp's free web version
details.future_scope: Steady; sustainable and green building design is a growing specialisation.

earnings.entry: ₹2–4 LPA typical for freshers
earnings.senior: Well-known architects and firm owners earn much more
earnings.note: Pay grows mainly with portfolio and reputation.

careers.name: Design (UX, Product & Communication)
careers.description: Design apps, products, brands and experiences that people love to use.
careers.education_path: Any stream → B.Des (4 years) via UCEED, NID DAT, NIFT or others → portfolio-driven career.
possible_challenges: Entrance exams test creativity, not marks
Career depends heavily on your portfolio
explore_next: Redesign a screen of an app you use and explain why
Keep a sketchbook of ideas

details.overview: Designers shape how products look and feel — the apps on your phone, packaging, logos and furniture all went through designers.
details.day_in_life: Talking to users, sketching ideas, building prototypes in tools like Figma, testing them, and refining.
how_to_prepare: Any stream works for design.
Practise sketching and observation.
Prepare for UCEED (IITs), NID DAT, NIFT.
start_now: Learn Figma's free basics
Start a portfolio — even school projects count
details.future_scope: Good: every digital product needs designers; UX designers with research skills are in demand.

earnings.entry: ₹2.5–6 LPA typical for UX/UI freshers
earnings.senior: ₹25 LPA+ for senior product designers
earnings.note: A strong portfolio matters more than the college name.

careers.name: Doctor (MBBS)
careers.description: Diagnose and treat illness, care for patients, and save lives.
careers.education_path: PCB → MBBS (5.5 years incl. internship) via NEET-UG → NEET-PG for MD/MS specialisation (3 years).
careers.timeline: 5.5 years for MBBS; 8.5–11 years to become a specialist.
possible_challenges: NEET is extremely competitive
Long study, long hours and emotionally demanding work
explore_next: Talk to a doctor about their day
Volunteer or shadow at a clinic if possible

details.overview: Doctors are among the most trusted and needed professionals in India, which still has too few doctors for its population.
details.day_in_life: Seeing patients, examining and diagnosing, ordering tests, prescribing treatment, ward rounds, and emergencies — often long shifts.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB. NEET is built directly on NCERT — know NCERT Biology line by line.
Take NEET-UG; government medical colleges via All-India (15%) and state quotas.
Practise full-length NEET mocks under time; Physics is often the deciding subject.
After MBBS: NEET-PG for specialisation.
start_now: Read NCERT Biology Class 11 Chapter 1–2 carefully
Take a timed NEET practice paper in MAYA's Mock Tests

entrance_exams.name: NEET-UG
entrance_exams.note: The only route to MBBS in India

details.future_scope: Always needed; specialists and doctors willing to serve smaller towns are in especially high demand.

earnings.entry: Government junior residents: ₹56,100 basic (Level 10) — about ₹60,000–85,000/month with allowances
earnings.mid: Specialists: ₹1.5–3 lakh+/month depending on field and city
earnings.senior: Senior specialists and surgeons earn much more, especially in private practice
earnings.note: Pay rises sharply after specialisation (MD/MS).

careers.name: Dentist (BDS)
careers.description: Care for teeth, gums and mouth health — from fillings to surgery.
careers.education_path: PCB → BDS (5 years incl. internship) via NEET-UG → optional MDS (3 years).
possible_challenges: Setting up a clinic needs investment
Crowded in big cities
explore_next: Visit a dentist and ask about their work
Read NCERT Biology on human physiology

details.overview: Dentists combine medicine with precise hands-on work. Many run their own clinics.
details.day_in_life: Examining patients, cleanings, fillings, root canals, braces and minor surgery, plus running a practice.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB.
NEET-UG (same exam as MBBS).
Master NCERT Biology.
start_now: Take a NEET Biology practice test in MAYA
Talk to a dentist about their career
details.future_scope: Steady demand; specialists (MDS) and those in smaller towns do best.

earnings.entry: ₹3–6 LPA as an associate dentist (indicative)
earnings.mid: ₹8–20 LPA with own practice or specialisation
earnings.senior: Established clinic owners and specialists earn much more
earnings.note: Indicative — income depends heavily on location and running a practice.

careers.name: Pharmacy
careers.description: Understand, make, test and dispense medicines.
careers.education_path: PCB or PCM → B.Pharm (4 years) via state CETs/CUET, or D.Pharm (2 years) → M.Pharm / Pharm.D.
possible_challenges: Retail pharmacy pay is modest
Research roles usually need M.Pharm
explore_next: Read how a medicine is tested before approval
Revise NCERT organic chemistry

details.overview: India is a global pharmacy hub; pharmacists work in manufacturing, research, quality control, hospitals and drug regulation.
details.day_in_life: Depending on the role: testing drug quality, running lab analyses, advising patients on medicines, or managing regulatory paperwork.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB or PCM.
State pharmacy CETs, CUET or college entrance tests.
Strong organic chemistry helps.
start_now: Revise NCERT chemistry: biomolecules and chemistry in everyday life
Read about India's pharmaceutical industry
details.future_scope: Steady: India's pharma exports and generic drug industry keep growing.

earnings.entry: ₹2.5–5 LPA for B.Pharm freshers
earnings.senior: Higher in regulatory affairs and R&D leadership
earnings.note: Government pharmacists earn ₹45,000–60,000+/month with allowances.

careers.name: Nursing
careers.description: Care for patients around the clock in hospitals and communities.
careers.education_path: PCB → B.Sc Nursing (4 years) via entrance tests (AIIMS, state, CUET/NEET in some states) → M.Sc Nursing optional.
possible_challenges: Shift work, including nights
Physically and emotionally demanding
explore_next: Learn basic first aid
Talk to a nurse about their work

details.overview: Nurses are the backbone of healthcare. Indian nurses are also in demand abroad.
details.day_in_life: Monitoring patients, giving medicines, assisting doctors, and supporting patients and families.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB.
Check your state's B.Sc Nursing entrance and AIIMS B.Sc Nursing.
Learn first aid and basic anatomy.
start_now: Take a first-aid course
Revise NCERT human physiology
details.future_scope: Strong demand in India and overseas.
after_completion: M.Sc Nursing → teaching or specialist nursing

earnings.entry: AIIMS nursing officers: Level 7 (₹44,900 basic), about ₹65,000–72,000/month in hand
earnings.mid: Higher with promotions; private hospital pay varies widely
earnings.senior: Nursing superintendents and nurses abroad earn much more
earnings.note: Private hospitals often pay less than government posts at entry level.

careers.name: Physiotherapy
careers.description: Help people recover movement after injuries, surgery or illness.
careers.education_path: PCB → BPT (4.5 years incl. internship); several states use NEET or their own tests → MPT optional.
possible_challenges: Private starting pay is low
Physically active work
explore_next: Read about sports physiotherapy
Learn the major muscles and bones

details.overview: Physiotherapists treat through movement and exercise — working with athletes, elderly people and patients after surgery.
details.day_in_life: Assessing patients, planning exercise programmes, hands-on therapy, and tracking recovery.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB.
Check your state's BPT admission route (NEET score or state test).
start_now: Learn basic human anatomy from NCERT
Watch how sports teams use physiotherapists

entrance_exams.name: NEET-UG (in some states)
entrance_exams.note: Used for BPT admission in several states

details.future_scope: Growing with sports, ageing population and fitness awareness.

earnings.entry: ₹15,000–25,000/month in private sector; ₹45,000–70,000/month in government roles
earnings.senior: Sports and private-practice physios can earn much more
earnings.note: Building a client base matters for private practice.

careers.name: Veterinary Doctor
careers.description: Care for animals — pets, livestock and wildlife.
careers.education_path: PCB → B.V.Sc & A.H. (5.5 years) via NEET (VCI 15% all-India quota) and state admissions.
possible_challenges: Rural and farm postings are common
Physically demanding work
explore_next: Visit a veterinary clinic or animal shelter
Read about animal husbandry in India

details.overview: Vets protect animal health — which also protects food safety and human health.
details.day_in_life: Treating animals, surgery, vaccinations, and advising farmers or pet owners; many government vets work in rural areas.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB.
NEET-UG for the VCI all-India quota; state veterinary admissions.
start_now: Volunteer at an animal shelter
Revise NCERT Biology on animal kingdom
details.future_scope: Steady; pet care and dairy industries are growing.

earnings.entry: Government veterinary officers: about ₹45,000–68,000/month depending on state; central posts at Level 10 (₹56,100 basic)
earnings.mid: Rises with promotions and private practice
earnings.senior: Specialists and established clinics earn more
earnings.note: Private starting pay varies widely.

sources.name: Govt. of India — Veterinary Officer at Level-10

careers.name: Biotechnology & Life Sciences Research
careers.description: Use living cells and DNA to make medicines, vaccines, crops and new materials.
careers.education_path: PCB/PCMB → B.Tech Biotech (JEE) or B.Sc (CUET/IISER) → M.Sc/M.Tech → PhD for research.
careers.timeline: 5–10 years (research careers usually need a PhD).
possible_challenges: Good research jobs need higher degrees
Industry jobs are concentrated in a few cities
explore_next: Read about how COVID vaccines were developed
Try a school science project with plants or microbes

details.overview: Biotechnologists and life scientists work at the cutting edge — gene therapy, vaccines, better crops, biofuels.
details.day_in_life: Designing experiments, lab work, analysing data, reading and writing research papers.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCB (PCMB keeps more doors open).
IISER Aptitude Test and NEST for research-focused B.S./M.Sc.
JEE for B.Tech Biotechnology; CUET for B.Sc.
start_now: Read NCERT Class 12 Biotechnology chapters
Follow science news (e.g. ICMR, DBT)
details.future_scope: Growing — India's bioeconomy is expanding quickly.

earnings.entry: PhD fellowships (JRF) ₹37,000/month; industry freshers roughly ₹3–6 LPA
earnings.mid: ₹8–18 LPA for scientists with a PhD
earnings.senior: Senior scientists and R&D heads earn more
earnings.note: Research careers pay off later but offer deep satisfaction; figures are indicative.

careers.name: Psychology
careers.description: Understand how people think and feel, and help them with mental health.
careers.education_path: Any stream → BA/B.Sc Psychology (3–4 years) via CUET → MA/M.Sc → M.Phil (clinical, RCI) for clinical practice.
careers.timeline: 5–7 years to practise as a clinical psychologist.
possible_challenges: Clinical practice needs long study and licensing
Early-career pay is low
explore_next: Read an introductory psychology book
Practise active listening with friends

details.overview: Psychologists study behaviour and help people cope — in clinics, schools, companies and research.
details.day_in_life: Counselling sessions, assessments, research or training, depending on the specialisation.
how_to_prepare: Any stream (psychology as a Class 11-12 subject helps).
CUET for central universities.
start_now: Read about emotions and the brain
Practise listening without interrupting
details.future_scope: Growing fast as mental-health awareness rises.

earnings.entry: ₹1.95–2.8 LPA for freshers
earnings.mid: ₹5–10 LPA with experience; industrial psychologists ₹8–10 LPA
earnings.senior: Established clinicians in private practice earn much more
earnings.note: Pay rises with qualifications and a client base.

careers.name: Scientific Research (Physics, Maths, Chemistry)
careers.description: Discover new knowledge — from particles and planets to new mathematics.
careers.education_path: PCM → BS-MS (5 years) at IISERs/NISER/IISc, or B.Sc → M.Sc → PhD.
careers.timeline: 9–11 years to become an independent scientist (including PhD).
possible_challenges: Long path with fellowships rather than high salaries early on
Few permanent research posts
explore_next: Read about Indian scientists like C. V. Raman or Srinivasa Ramanujan
Try olympiad-style problems

details.overview: Researchers ask questions no one has answered. India's IISERs, IISc and national labs offer excellent paths with scholarships.
details.day_in_life: Reading papers, doing experiments or calculations, writing code, discussing ideas, teaching.
how_to_prepare: Class 11-12: PCM (or PCMB).
IISER Aptitude Test, NEST, IISc admission via JEE/KVPY-successor routes.
Try science olympiads.
start_now: Try an olympiad problem set
Apply for the INSPIRE scholarship when eligible
details.future_scope: Research funding in India is growing; scientific training also opens data and finance careers.

earnings.entry: JRF fellowship ₹37,000/month during PhD
earnings.mid: Assistant professors and scientists typically at Level 10+ (₹56,100 basic and up)
earnings.senior: Senior professors and scientists earn well with stable benefits
earnings.note: Quantitative finance or data roles pay more for scientists who switch.

careers.name: Chartered Accountancy (CA)
careers.description: Manage money for companies — accounts, audits, taxes and financial advice.
careers.education_path: Any stream (commerce helps) → CA Foundation → Intermediate → articleship (practical training) → CA Final, conducted by ICAI.
careers.timeline: About 4.5–5 years after class 12; many take longer.
possible_challenges: Low pass rates — it takes persistence
Busy periods around tax deadlines
explore_next: Look at ICAI's student section
Learn how a simple balance sheet works

details.overview: CAs are among the most respected finance professionals in India, trusted with audits, taxes and company finances.
details.day_in_life: Auditing accounts, preparing tax filings, advising businesses and checking compliance.
how_to_prepare: Commerce stream with accountancy helps (not compulsory).
Register for CA Foundation after class 12.
Practise accounts daily; the exams test consistency.
start_now: Learn double-entry bookkeeping basics
Read ICAI's CA Foundation syllabus
details.future_scope: Stable and respected; routine bookkeeping is being automated, so advisory and analysis skills matter more.

earnings.entry: ₹7.2–32 LPA through ICAI campus placements (average about ₹12.9 LPA, Aug–Sep 2025)
earnings.senior: CFOs and partners earn far more
earnings.note: Small firms may start at ₹3–4 LPA.

careers.name: Economics & Finance
careers.description: Understand markets and money — banking, investing, policy and business strategy.
careers.education_path: Any stream (maths helps) → B.A./B.Sc Economics or BBA/B.Com via CUET → MBA/MA Economics/CFA.
possible_challenges: Top finance jobs are very competitive
Needs comfort with maths and data
explore_next: Follow the RBI's monetary policy decisions
Track a few company stocks on paper

details.overview: Economists and finance professionals decide where money goes — in banks, companies, markets and government.
details.day_in_life: Analysing data and reports, building financial models, meeting clients or writing policy notes.
how_to_prepare: Maths in Class 11-12 is very useful.
CUET for Delhi University and other central universities.
Read business news regularly.
start_now: Read one business news story daily
Learn what inflation and interest rates do
details.future_scope: Strong; people who combine finance with data skills are especially valued.

earnings.entry: ₹4–8 LPA typical; top-college graduates in investment banking or consulting earn much more
earnings.mid: ₹10–30 LPA after an MBA or experience
earnings.senior: Very high in investment banking and leadership
earnings.note: Indicative; outcomes vary widely by college and role.

careers.name: Law
careers.description: Argue cases, advise companies, protect rights and shape justice.
careers.education_path: Any stream → 5-year integrated BA/BBA LLB via CLAT (National Law Universities), AILET or state tests → enrol with the Bar Council.
possible_challenges: Courtroom practice pays little in the first few years
Heavy reading
explore_next: Watch a court proceeding or moot court online
Read one Supreme Court judgment summary

details.overview: Lawyers work in courts, companies, government and human-rights organisations. NLU graduates are recruited by top law firms.
details.day_in_life: Reading cases and contracts, drafting documents, advising clients, and arguing in court.
how_to_prepare: Any stream works.
CLAT tests English, reasoning, legal reasoning, current affairs and basic maths.
Read a newspaper editorial every day.
start_now: Read and summarise one editorial daily
Try a past CLAT paper
details.future_scope: Strong for corporate, technology and IP law.

earnings.entry: Top NLU graduates: ₹12–25 LPA at top law firms; NLU averages about ₹16–20 LPA
earnings.senior: Senior advocates and partners earn much more
earnings.note: Litigation starts much lower and grows with reputation.

careers.name: Civil Services (IAS, IPS, IFS)
careers.description: Run districts, police, and foreign policy — serve the country at the highest level.
careers.education_path: Any graduation degree → UPSC Civil Services Exam (prelims, mains, interview).
careers.timeline: Graduation (3–4 years) + 1–3 years of UPSC preparation.
possible_challenges: One of the toughest exams in the world
Frequent transfers
explore_next: Read a newspaper daily
Read NCERT History and Polity books

details.overview: Civil servants implement government policy — from district collectors to diplomats.
details.day_in_life: Meetings, field visits, solving public problems, managing crises and teams.
how_to_prepare: Choose any degree you'll enjoy (many pick history, political science, economics or engineering).
Build a newspaper habit early.
NCERT books (Class 6–12) are the foundation for UPSC.
start_now: Read one newspaper every day
Start NCERT Polity (Class 11)
details.future_scope: Always relevant; very high responsibility and respect.

earnings.entry: Pay Level 10: ₹56,100 basic + allowances, housing and other benefits
earnings.mid: Rises through the pay matrix with promotions
earnings.senior: Cabinet Secretary level is the top of the government pay scale
earnings.note: Government pay per the 7th Pay Commission.

sources.name: Level-10 pay (₹56,100–1,77,500) per Govt. of India notice

careers.name: Defence Officer (Army, Navy, Air Force)
careers.description: Lead soldiers, sailors or aircrew and protect the country.
careers.education_path: After class 12: NDA exam (UPSC) → 3 years at NDA + 1 year training. Or graduate entry via CDS, AFCAT, or technical entries.
possible_challenges: Strict fitness and medical standards
Postings in remote and tough areas
explore_next: Join NCC
Start a running and fitness routine

details.overview: Defence officers lead with courage and discipline, with excellent benefits and respect.
details.day_in_life: Training, leading troops, operations, and continuous physical and professional preparation.
how_to_prepare: PCM required for Navy/Air Force via NDA.
Take the NDA exam (UPSC) — then the SSB interview.
Build fitness and join NCC.
start_now: Run and exercise regularly
Read about SSB interviews
details.future_scope: Stable; technical branches increasingly value engineering skills.

earnings.entry: Lieutenant: Pay Level 10 (₹56,100 basic) plus military service pay and allowances
earnings.senior: Senior officers are at the top of the pay matrix, with pension and benefits
earnings.note: Includes free medical care, housing and canteen facilities.

sources.name: Level-10 pay (₹56,100–1,77,500) per Govt. of India notice

careers.name: Journalism & Media
careers.description: Find and tell true stories — in news, digital media, film and podcasts.
careers.education_path: Any stream → BJMC/BA Mass Communication (3 years) via CUET or college tests → IIMC PG diploma optional.
possible_challenges: Low starting pay
Irregular hours
explore_next: Start a blog or school newsletter
Interview someone and write their story

details.overview: Journalists and media professionals inform the public — a job that's moving fast from print and TV to digital.
details.day_in_life: Researching, interviewing, writing or filming, editing, and meeting deadlines.
how_to_prepare: Any stream.
Write regularly and read widely.
CUET for central universities; IIMC for PG.
start_now: Write one short article a week
Record and edit a short video story
details.future_scope: Digital storytelling, video and data journalism are growing.

earnings.entry: ₹2.5–5 LPA for freshers
earnings.senior: Senior editors, anchors and producers earn more
earnings.note: Varies strongly by outlet.

careers.name: Teaching & Education
careers.description: Teach and inspire the next generation — in schools, colleges or online.
careers.education_path: Graduation in your subject → B.Ed (2 years) → CTET/state TET for school teaching; or Master's → NET/PhD for college teaching.
careers.timeline: 5 years after class 12 for school teaching.
possible_challenges: Private school pay can be low
Large classes
explore_next: Tutor a younger student
Explain a topic to a friend and see if they get it

details.overview: Good teachers change lives. Government teaching posts are stable and respected; online education has opened new paths too.
details.day_in_life: Planning and giving lessons, checking work, guiding students, and meeting parents.
how_to_prepare: Pick the subject you love most for graduation.
B.Ed after graduation; clear CTET/state TET.
start_now: Tutor a younger student
Make a short explainer video on a topic you know
details.future_scope: Steady; teachers with digital skills are in demand.

earnings.entry: KVS PGTs start at Pay Level 8 (₹47,600 basic); private schools often pay much less
earnings.senior: Principals and professors earn more
earnings.note: Government posts come with stable pay and pension benefits.

careers.name: Hotel Management & Hospitality
careers.description: Run hotels, restaurants, events and travel experiences.
careers.education_path: Any stream → B.Sc Hospitality & Hotel Administration (3 years) via NCHM JEE (IHMs).
possible_challenges: Long hours, weekends and festivals
Low starting pay
explore_next: Organise a family event end to end
Try cooking a full meal for guests

details.overview: Hospitality professionals run hotels, airlines' cabin services, cruises, restaurants and events — and can work across the world.
details.day_in_life: Managing guests and staff, operations, kitchens, and events.
how_to_prepare: Any stream.
NCHM JEE for the Institutes of Hotel Management.
Work on communication and grooming.
start_now: Help organise a school or family event
Learn basic cooking
details.future_scope: Growing with tourism; international opportunities are common.

earnings.entry: ₹1.8–3 LPA for freshers
earnings.senior: General managers, top chefs and overseas roles earn much more
earnings.note: Tips and international postings can raise income.
